conclusion: GTK2 hint assignment is covered for 16 native control types and 31 widgets/compound descendants. Four explicit semantic-role fixtures rendered the expected tooltip pixels in both embedded and separate hosts. T07 remains partial: the palette test does not validate the production role exporter; other layouts/states, GTK3/4/Qt/Plasma coverage limits listed in the inventory and visual review remain.
